artworks.title: Henrici VIII Angliae, Franciae et Hiberniam Rex (King Henry VIII)
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man in royal attire. He is shown in a front-facing position, with a round face, beard, mustache, and hair styled back under a luxurious hat. He wears an ornate coat with a fur collar and decorative patterns, as well as jewelry. He holds a royal scepter in one hand and an orb in the other. The background features scroll-like designs, banners with inscriptions, two coats of arms above the portrait, and a caption below it.

artworks.title: Henry VIII
artworks.description: The image is a portrait depicting the upper body of a person seated in a frontal position. They have distinct facial features including a noticeable nose, heavy-lidded eyes, and a neatly-trimmed beard and mustache. The individual is wearing a richly decorated headwear with circles and geometric elements, and their clothing is adorned with what appears to be a fur collar. The background has horizontal lines, and at the bottom, there is an inscription in a stylized font that reads "HENRICUS VIII Rex. Angliae."

artworks.title: Henry VIII
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the chest up. He has a broad, round face with a slight frown and heavy-lidded eyes. His hands are clasped together in front of him. He wears a large hat with pearls or small points, a fur collar, and layers of formal attire. Inscriptions on the oval frame surrounding the image include the name "Henricus VIII". The background features a pattern.

artworks.title: Henry VIII
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a man from the chest up, facing forward with his hands clasped together. His facial features are detailed, including a prominent chin, high cheekbones, and deep-set eyes. He has short hair and a beard, and is wearing a richly adorned hat with a band featuring intricate patterns, as well as a fur collar. He is dressed in elaborate garments with visible intricate details on the fabric. The background includes a decorative oval frame with surrounding text and ornate designs, alongside a coat of arms in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Henry VIII
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up. He faces slightly to the left with his hands clasped in front of him. The man has prominent cheeks, a small closed mouth, and a short, neatly trimmed beard. He wears an elaborately adorned hat with jewels and a feather, an opulent robe with a fur collar, and detailed fabric around his neck. He wears a ring on his right hand and holds a small object. A coat of arms is seen in the background, with an inscription above reading "HENRICVS DEI GRA REX ANGLIAE" and the year 1549 inscribed beside the coat of arms.

artworks.title: Henry VIII
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the left with a direct gaze. He has a full beard and mustache, a prominent nose, slightly furrowed brows, and short hair peeking out from underneath a jeweled and feathered hat. He is dressed in regal attire, including a fur-lined cloak, embroidered garment, and heavy chains. He holds a scepter in his right hand and wears various jewelry. The background is a finely etched texture.

artworks.title: Henry, Duke of Savoy, Nemours and Geneva
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a man from the chest up, captured in a semi-profile seated position with his face turned to look directly at the viewer. He has a full beard, mustache, voluminous curled hair, and an elaborate ruffled collar. The man wears a richly decorated jacket with embroidered patterns and large decorative buttons. The background features lines creating a halo-like effect around his head, enclosed within an oval frame. Surrounding the frame is text.

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: This is a genealogical tree illustration. It features a detailed family tree with various interconnected branches and circular nodes holding names and genealogical information. At the top center, there is an oval portrait of a man framed and connected to the main ancestor, with descendant names branching outwards. Each name is enclosed in a circle branching off from the central trunk. Some circles are adorned with crowns, potentially indicating royal status. The structure is supported by a shield with heraldic designs at the bottom. The drawing includes botanical elements such as leaves and flowers, as well as Latin text, enhancing its historical and intricate appearance.

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image shows a monochrome portrait of a person displaying their upper body. The person faces forward in a formal pose with their right shoulder slightly turned. They have curly, shoulder-length hair and a youthful face with a calm expression. The person wears a garment with a buttoned shirt, a high decorative collar, and a sash across the shoulder. The frame around them includes text reading "HENRICVS WALLIAE PRINCEPS." The background includes heraldic designs with a crown, a lion, and a mythical creature. Below the portrait, there is decorative text in Latin.

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image depicts a person from the waist up, facing slightly to the right but looking directly at the viewer. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair and a calm expression. They wear a garment with a lace collar and decorative trim, possibly a buttoned vest over a shirt, with a sash draped across their shoulder and a small brooch pinned to it. The border includes text reading “HENRICUS WALLIAE PRINCEPS,” surrounded by ornamental elements like crowns and heraldic symbols. The background is ornate with engravings, including a lion on the left and a dragon's tail on the right. Below the portrait is a block of Latin text followed by the name "Crispin van de Pas."

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a portrait of a person with styled hair, a textured collar, and intricate clothing. The background features a textured oval frame with inscriptions and text below the portrait on the paper.

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraved portrait of a person from the chest upwards, slightly turned to the right. The individual has a high forehead and styled hair. They are wearing a detailed garment with a lace ruff collar, a robe with a sash, and are framed within an oval border with Latin inscriptions. The background features printed text from an aged document, with a torn edge on the left side.

artworks.title: Prince Henry with the Pike
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a man in Renaissance clothing balancing a rapier on his outstretched arm. He has short hair and a mustache, and is wearing elaborate clothing with a sword at his hip. In the background, there is a decorative crest emblem, armor, and a decorative pattern.

artworks.title: Prince Henry with the Pike
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing poised with a long spear-like weapon resting on their shoulder. The individual is facing right, with their right hand grasping the spear near the head and their left hand holding it toward the end. They have sharp facial features and short hair styled upwards. The person is dressed in a historical outfit with a puffed doublet and knee-length breeches with decorations, a sash, and pointed shoes. Their legs are in a fencing stance. The ground appears patterned, and there is a detailed drawing of a plumed helmet and feathers in the background. The image is bordered by a frame and surrounded by a blank area on a worn page with printed text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Henry Frederick, Prince of Wales
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a central bust portrait of an individual within an ornate oval frame. The person depicted has a youthful appearance with short, neatly styled hair, fine facial features, and wears a ruffled lace collar and detailed armor. Flanking the oval frame are two figures; one on the left is a warrior with a helmet and spear, while the figure on the right is draped in flowing garments. Above the portrait are two cherubs, one holding a circular emblem under a decorative drapery, and a columned structure in the background. Below the portrait is a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: Henrici VIII Angliae, Franciae et Hiberniam Rex (King Henry VIII)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man positioned in a formal pose. He has a serious expression, with closely set eyes, a straight nose, and lips that are slightly pursed. His hair is styled in a short, voluminous manner with curls. He is adorned in an elaborate attire featuring a richly embroidered doublet and a large ruffled collar. Across his chest runs a diagonal sash secured with decorative brooch-like objects, and he holds a baton-like object in his right hand. Surrounding the portrait is an oval frame with inscriptions, and above the frame is a crest. The background is elaborate, with illustrations of armor and weaponry on either side.

artworks.title: Prince Henry's Hearse
artworks.artist: Willem de Passe and Magdalena de Passe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate funeral monument. The image shows an architectural structure resembling a catafalque or tomb. The structure is adorned with heraldic symbols and a recumbent effigy of a figure in elaborate attire. A canopy supported by columns covers the effigy. The structure is embellished with intricate decorations, including crests and possible coats of arms. Latin text surrounds the monument, suggesting a memorial or tribute.

artworks.title: Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image shows a man dressed in armor, holding a baton or scepter upright. He has long, wavy hair and a long, narrow face with a defined nose, looking directly at the viewer. He is positioned in a three-quarter view and there is a table with a helmet beside him. The background features a draped fabric.

artworks.title: Frederick Henry of Nassau
artworks.description: The image depicts an engraving of a man from the waist up. He is standing in a three-quarter profile with his body slightly turned to the right. The man's face is turned towards the viewer, showing facial features such as a pronounced nose, a strong jawline, and curly, shoulder-length hair. He is dressed in ornate armor with a high, ridged collar. On the table before him, there is a detailed helmet and a baton-like object. The man is surrounded by an intricate frame featuring mythological figures, heraldic symbols, and architectural elements. Above him, two figures hold large feathery plumes. Behind the man is an interior setting with columns, and through an archway, an exterior cityscape with a river and buildings can be seen. Decorative text is included in the background.

artworks.title: Henry Julius, Duke of Brunswick, Bishop of Halberstadt
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man in an ornate oval frame. He has facial hair, fine eyebrows, and long hair pulled back. He has a high forehead and is wearing sophisticated clothing with a ruffled collar and a sash across his chest. The frame around him is detailed with scrolls, a shield, and inscriptions. The background has a dense pattern.

artworks.title: Balthasarus ab Herden Med. Doctor
artworks.description: The image displays half of a person's body, focusing on the upper torso and head. The person is seated or slightly turned forward, facing the viewer. The individual has a prominent nose, thin lips, a thin beard with a mustache, and short, modestly styled hair covered by a hat. The person wears traditional 17th-century clothing, including a large pleated ruff collar and a fur-trimmed coat. There are no visible jewelry items or objects. The background features an oval frame with decorative scrollwork and text.

artworks.title: Balthasarus ab Herden Med. Doctor
artworks.description: The image displays an engraving of a man from the chest up, seated or standing neutrally. He has a serious expression and features such as deep-set eyes, a strong nose, a neatly trimmed mustache and beard, and his hair is covered by a cap. He wears a pleated ruff collar and a dark fur-trimmed garment typical of 17th-century European attire. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background features an ornate framed border with scrolling decorations and detailed text about his life and achievements. The style suggests a formal portrait intended to convey stature and dignity.

artworks.title: Martin Herpert
artworks.artist: Willem Hondius after Crispijn de Passe I
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the shoulders up. He is positioned facing forward, slightly turned to his right. The man has a well-groomed mustache and short hair, revealing a high forehead. He wears a pleated ruff collar around his neck and a dark garment. Draped across his chest is a chain. The background consists of a patterned oval frame with inscriptions along its edge, which further contains additional text below the portrait.

artworks.title: Joannes Heurnius, Medical Professor and Rector of Academy at Leyden
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man's bust, facing forward with his body turned slightly to his left. He has a beard, mustache, high forehead, deep-set eyes, and short, combed-back hair. He is wearing a high, elaborate ruffled collar over a fur-trimmed garment. The background features intricate engravings, including a frame with Latin text around the portrait and ornate decorations below with garlands and architectural elements. An angelic cherub is depicted in the border above his head.
